statement_html:
Desenvolupar i reduir l'expressió \(\left(2 z - 13\right)^{2}\).
La teua resposta :
\(\left(2 z - 13\right)^{2} =\) .
solution_html:
\(({\color{purple}} 2 z {\color{black}} - {\color{blue}} 13 {\color{black}})^2\) = \(({\color{purple}}2 z{\color{black}})^2\) - \(2\times {\color{purple}}2 z{\color{black}}\times{\color{blue}}13{\color{black}}\) + \(({\color{blue}}13{\color{black}})^2\)
= \(4 z^{2}\) - \(52 z\) + \(169\)
= \(4 z^{2} - 52 z + 169\)
